extra.reason: Froze PlecSsrSnapshot v1 in crates/plec-ir: Rust-owned camelCase schema (route chain+params+phase, public exports reusing PublicExport/validate_public_export, loader outcomes derived from manifest entries, per-instance structural ownership with branch/loop node handles) plus fail-closed validate() against manifest+application. 30 tests incl. serde round-trip and one negative per rule; no TS schema added; doc pointer added to docs/ssr-architecture.md.

Adoption claims now resolve through one TypedAdoptionIndex per scope (TypedAdoptionScope::Element|Range), built in a single walk: element data-plec-node attributes and ownership comments share one map; repeated markers fail adoption with duplicate:ssr-marker:{marker} instead of last-wins; nested component adoptions claim the sibling range between their plec:component[-end] markers so they no longer re-walk the whole root; all missing:ssr-* / mismatch:ssr-tag codes unchanged. Verified: cargo lib tests 27 passed; wasm-bindgen suite 34 passed incl. 3 new adversarial-adoption tests (scoped-walk counter <45 vs >=45 full-root rewalk, duplicate marker, missing/mismatch codes) and the nested grandchild action/binding stays live on server DOM; apps/fullstack acceptance-adoption.mjs passed against rebuilt runtime wasm.
Compile-time swap implemented and verified: dotenvy parses .env.plec, rustc-env bakes release/development, rerun-if-changed triggers rebuild on file edit, cargo fmt/test pass, binary smoke-tested.

Gated fetch_uses_json_stringify_results_as_raw_request_bodies with #[cfg(feature = "fetch")]; test:core (cargo test --no-default-features --lib) now compiles and passes 27/27, and the fetch-enabled build still includes and passes the test

test:core (cargo test --no-default-features, all targets) compiles and passes 27/27; the fetch-only unit test in typed/vm.rs is now gated with #[cfg(feature = "fetch")] and runs only in the default-feature build where it passes

Import pipeline landed: v2 bootstrap (plec-server bootstrapPayload) carries the PlecSsrSnapshot; browser readSsrBootstrap discriminates null/invalid(unparseable→invalid:ssr-bootstrap)/legacy/v2 and calls new start_adopt_snapshot; WASM parses+gates (unsupported:ssr-snapshot-version, stale-revision, mismatch:ssr-snapshot-payload, mismatch:ssr-snapshot:* via full plec-ir validate through new SsrStructureApplication trait implemented by TypedComponentApplication) and checks request-location identity (mismatch:ssr-location) before seeding public exports+location into shared host inputs so adoption claims DOM with imported state (apply_static_bindings stays the single re-evaluation point); abandon_adoption purges seeded keys; binding-value divergence is allowed and observed via ssr_text_divergences counter + snapshotImported/textDivergences on the adopted diagnostic, documented in docs/ssr-architecture.md. Verified: cargo lib 27/27, wasm-bindgen 40/40 incl. 6 new snapshot tests (seeding, divergence, version/revision gates, payload/structure fail-closed, location mismatch, abandon purge), plec-ir 30/30, plec-browser vitest 8/8, plec-server vitest 1/1, typechecks clean, acceptance-adoption.mjs passed.
